name: Setup Player Controller
description: Creates a complete player controller setup with movement, camera, and input handling for common game types.
author: Splatter

parameters.name: moveSpeed
parameters.description: Movement speed in units per second

parameters.name: useNewInputSystem
parameters.description: Use the new Input System package instead of legacy Input

parameters.name: includeCinemachine
parameters.description: Setup Cinemachine virtual camera for smooth camera following

instructions:
Set up a complete player controller based on the specified controller type:

1. Create the Player GameObject hierarchy:
   - Player (root with CharacterController or Rigidbody)
   - PlayerModel (child for visual representation)
   - CameraTarget (child for camera following)

2. Based on controllerType:
   - 'fps': First-person controller with mouse look, WASD movement
   - 'tps': Third-person controller with orbit camera, WASD movement
   - 'topdown': Top-down controller with click-to-move or WASD
   - 'platformer': Side-scroller with jump, run, WASD/Arrow keys

3. Create necessary scripts:
   - PlayerController.cs with movement logic
   - PlayerInput.cs for input handling
   - CameraController.cs for camera behavior

4. If useNewInputSystem:
   - Create InputActions asset
   - Configure action maps for the controller type
   - Generate C# wrapper class

5. If includeCinemachine:
   - Create appropriate virtual camera
   - Configure follow and look-at targets
   - Set up camera collision if TPS

6. Configure physics:
   - Add appropriate colliders
   - Set up layers and collision matrix

examples.input: Create an FPS controller with Cinemachine
examples.output: Created Player with FPS controller, mouse look, Cinemachine POV camera

examples.input: Create a third-person controller without new input system
examples.output: Created Player with TPS controller using legacy Input, orbit camera

examples.input: Create a platformer controller at speed 8
examples.output: Created Player with 2D platformer controller, jump mechanics, speed 8
